goal:
In kestrel-team (Python; gate `uv run --locked python -m pytest tests/ -q`,
fully mocked, no network; base = main 87db78c), make `spawner cloud ingest`
refuse to decide `delivery` on silence. READ CLAUDE.md FIRST. Nothing else
changes (0025 decision 2). Ingest must NOT try to open a PR itself: the
seat's `gh` fails TLS in its sandbox and the cloud session has no credentials.

Facts (seat, 2026-10-31, on 87db78c). `core/cloud_ingest.py` line 273
`pr_url = (pr_url or "").strip() or _one_from(report_text, PR_URL, "PR URL",
"--pr")` and line 280 `delivery = "delivered" if pr_url else "undelivered"`:
with neither `--pr` nor a PR URL in the RUN REPORT the row is written
`undelivered`, `pr_url: null`, exit 0. An ingest is never repeated and no
command amends a row (module doc lines 9–13), so that one call decides
`delivery` for all time. The instance ledger `~/.kestrel/runs.jsonl` holds
four such rows, every one of whose runs merged: `cloud-0072-… aborted
undelivered None`, `cloud-0076-… aborted undelivered None`, `cloud-0077-…
done undelivered None`, `cloud-0078-… aborted undelivered None`. The
discipline "open the PR first, then `ingest --pr`" sits in prose
(practice-helm queue/0007 context_pointers); practice-helm decisions/0003:
prose never constrains.

Do this, in `core/cloud_ingest.py`: (1) after `PR_URL` (line 77) add the
constant `NO_PR_URL = ("no PR URL is known (pass --pr URL, or --undelivered
to record a run that shipped nothing)")`. (2) `ingest()` (line 210) takes a
new keyword-only `undelivered: bool = False` after `out`. (3) Immediately
after line 273, exactly these four lines, as code:
    if pr_url and undelivered:
        raise CloudIngestError(f"--undelivered contradicts the PR URL {pr_url}: pass one or the other.")
    if not pr_url and not undelivered:
        raise CloudIngestError(NO_PR_URL)
